explanation: A phenol (pKa ≈ 10) is deprotonated by NaOH (and K₂CO₃), but not by NaHCO₃ (carbonic acid pKa ≈ 6.4 is a weaker acid than... its conjugate base is too weak).
tip: NaOH yes, NaHCO₃ no, for a plain phenol.
